notes: The 2016–2017 t-tests are named; the test behind the 'by univariate analyses' subgroup differences is not, so it is recorded as an unnamed test. The Discussion's 67% decline since 1965 is a percent change from Figure 1 trend data.
view_issues: The methods state t-tests only for 2016 vs 2017 overall differences, yet subgroup 'higher than' claims are made 'by univariate analyses' without a stated test. The 2016 sample size in the footnote (26,742) duplicates the 2017 figure.
